title: 第二十七章 大典第二十八章 封印解除
lines: 大典当日。洛阳城，祭天台。
天还没亮，城中已经热闹起来。街道两旁的店铺张灯结彩，家家户户门前挂上了红色的绸缎。修士联盟的弟子在城中巡逻，维持秩序。洛天王朝的士兵把守在各个路口，盘查过往行人。这是洛天王朝一年中最重要的日子，没有人敢怠慢。
祭天台的台阶从子时开始就有人清扫，扫了三遍，又用清水冲了三遍。玉石铺就的台阶在晨光中泛着温润的光，像一条白色的河流，从地面流向高台。高台上，十二尊生肖神像一字排开，每一尊都有三丈之高，青石雕刻，面目庄严。龙在正中，左右分别是虎、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪、鼠、牛、兔。十二正神，守护苍生。
辰时，祭天台下已经站满了人。文武百官按品级排列，穿着各色官服，像一片彩色的云。各方势力的代表站在两侧，有修士联盟的长老，有各大宗门的弟子，有散修中的知名人物。百姓被挡在远处，只能踮着脚尖远远张望。
祭天台东侧，临时搭建的看台上，坐着一位修士联盟的使者。是一个五十多岁的老者，面容清瘦，目光如炬，修为化神初期。他的袖口绣着金色的云纹，胸前绣着一座山峰的图案——修士联盟的标志。
祭天大典是洛天王朝的大事，修士联盟虽然不直接插手王朝事务，但派使者观礼是惯例。洛天王朝是天阙宗的附庸，而天阙宗是修士联盟的成员，联盟不会放过任何一个展示存在感的机会。所以名为观礼，实为宣示权力。
老者坐在看台上，目光扫过人群。定在了祖破天身上。宗主亲自来了，带了一百三十七个高手，分布在洛阳城各处。这不是来找儿子的阵仗。他眯起眼睛，没有说话。
祖破军站在祭天台西侧。他的身后，空无一人。十二个长老、二十五个执事、一百个内门弟子，分布在城东、城西、城南、城北、城中央的节点上。这是影七的要求，也是他的承诺。
只要人到位，儿子就回来。
现在人到位了，儿子也回来了。
他不知道，一切才刚刚开始。
辰时三刻，皇帝登台。年轻的皇帝穿着黑色的衮服，头戴十二旒冕冠，一步一步走上祭天台的台阶。他的步伐很稳，但握在袖中的手在微微发抖。天阙宗宗主亲自来了，带了这么多的高手。修士联盟的使者坐在看台上，目光如刀。他知道，今天的祭天大典，不只是一场仪式这么简单。
皇帝在祭天台中央站定，面向十二尊生肖神像，焚香，跪拜，宣读祭文。
就在这时，地脉颤动了，天空中乌云迅速聚拢，骤然暗了下来。
不是缓慢的颤动，是剧烈的震动。地面在摇晃，祭天台的台阶在开裂，十二尊生肖神像在颤抖。皇帝差点摔倒，被身边的侍卫扶住。人群中爆发出惊呼声，有人摔倒，有人尖叫，有人四处张望。
“怎么回事？”
“地震？”
“不是地震——是地脉！”
祖破军的脸色变了。他感觉到了——地脉中的力量在被抽取，流向祭天台下方。有什么东西在苏醒。他的灵力在流失。不是被攻击，是被抽取。他此刻就像站在漩涡中，灵力不受控制地流向地下。他的伤还没有好，他的修为不稳，而他的灵力在飞速消耗。
城东。宅院中，天阙宗长老的身体在发抖。他的灵力在飞速流失，脸色苍白，眼睛失焦。他想站起来，但脚像被钉在了地上。不是被定住，是不能动，确切地说是动不了。身体在抗拒，本能地恐惧。他张了张嘴，想说什么，却发不出声音。然后他倒下了。
城西。城南。城北。城中央。每一个节点上，天阙宗的人都在倒下。十二个长老，二十五个执事，一百个内门弟子。这些人是天阙宗的中坚力量，是宗门运转的根基。他们被抽干了灵力，身体像干涸的河床，苍白、枯瘦、没有生机。
一百三十七人，全部倒下了。
人群中，一个灰白色的身影走了出来。兜帽压得很低，遮住了大半张脸。他一步一步走上祭天台，站在皇帝身边，俯视台下。
影七摘下兜帽，露出真容。台下没有人认识这张脸。但所有人都认识他身上的气息——灰白色的、阴冷的、带着腐朽的味道。
“暗影神殿。”
四个字像四把刀，扎进每一个人的心里。
影七抬起手，黑色的雾气从地下的裂口中涌出，缠绕在他的手臂上。
“这座城，归我了。”发出了来自地狱的声音。
content_en:
The day of the grand ceremony. Luoyang City, offering sacrifices to the rooftop.
It's not yet dawn, but the city is already bustling with activity. Shops on both sides of the street were decorated with lights and red satin was hung in front of every house. Disciples from the Monk Alliance patrol the city to maintain order. Soldiers from the Luotian Dynasty guarded various intersections, checking passers-by. This is the most important day of the year in the Luotian Dynasty, and no one dares to neglect it.
The steps of the rooftop sacrifice platform have been cleaned since midnight, swept three times and flushed three times with clean water. The steps paved with jade glowed warmly in the morning light, like a white river flowing from the ground to the high platform. On the high platform, twelve zodiac statues are lined up, each one is three feet high, carved in bluestone, and has a solemn face. The dragon is in the center, and on the left and right are tiger, snake, horse, sheep, monkey, rooster, dog, pig, rat, ox and rabbit. The Twelve Righteous Gods protect the common people.
At midnight, there were already people standing under the altar. Civil and military officials are arranged according to rank, wearing official uniforms of various colors, like a colorful cloud. Representatives of all forces stood on both sides, including elders from the monk alliance, disciples from various major sects, and well-known figures in casual cultivation. The people were blocked in the distance and could only stand on tiptoes and look far away.
On the east side of the memorial platform, sitting on the temporary stand, was an envoy from the Monk Alliance. He is an old man in his fifties, with a thin face and blazing eyes. He is in the early stages of becoming a god. His cuffs were embroidered with golden cloud patterns, and his chest was embroidered with a mountain peak - the symbol of the Monks' Alliance.
The heaven-sacrifice ceremony was a major event for the Luotian Dynasty. Although the monk alliance did not directly intervene in the affairs of the dynasty, it was customary to send envoys to observe the ceremony. The Luotian Dynasty is a vassal of the Tianque Sect, and the Tianque Sect is a member of the Monk Alliance. The alliance will not miss any opportunity to show its presence. Therefore, it is called Guan Li, which is actually a declaration of power.
The old man sat in the stands and glanced at the crowd. It was fixed on Zu Potian. The sect master came in person, bringing with him one hundred and thirty-seven masters who were distributed throughout Luoyang City. This is not a battle to find his son. He narrowed his eyes and said nothing.
Zu Pojun stood on the west side of the sacrifice platform. Behind him, there was no one. Twelve elders, twenty-five deacons, and one hundred inner disciples are distributed at the nodes in the east, west, south, north, and center of the city. This is Ying Qi's request and his promise.
As long as the people are in place, my son will come back.
Now the people are in place and my son is back.
Little did he know, everything had just begun.
At three quarters of the hour, the emperor came on stage. The young emperor wore black robes and twelve crowns on his head, and walked up the steps of the sacrifice platform step by step. His steps were steady, but the hands in his sleeves were shaking slightly. The leader of Tianque Sect came in person and brought so many masters with him. The envoy of the Monk Alliance sat in the stands, his eyes like daggers. He knew that today's heaven-sacrifice ceremony was not just a simple ceremony.
The emperor stood in the center of the sacrificial platform, facing the twelve zodiac gods, burned incense, knelt down and read the sacrificial text.
At this moment, the earth's veins trembled, dark clouds quickly gathered in the sky, and it suddenly became dark.
Not a slow tremor, but a violent vibration. The ground was shaking, the steps of the rooftop altar were cracking, and the twelve zodiac statues were trembling. The emperor almost fell down and was supported by the guards around him. The crowd erupted in exclamations, some fell, some screamed, some looked around.
"What's going on?"
"Earthquake?"
"It's not an earthquake - it's a ley line!"
Zu Pojun's expression changed. He felt it - the power in the earth's veins was being extracted, flowing to the bottom of the altar. Something is awakening. His spiritual power was draining away. Not being attacked, but being extracted. He felt like he was standing in a whirlpool at the moment, with his spiritual energy flowing underground uncontrollably. His injuries have not healed yet, his cultivation is unstable, and his spiritual power is rapidly depleting.
——
East of the city. In the courtyard, the body of the Tianque Sect elder was trembling. His spiritual energy was rapidly draining, his face was pale, and his eyes were out of focus. He tried to stand up, but his feet felt like they were nailed to the ground. It's not that it's frozen, it's that it can't move. To be precise, it can't move. The body is resisting, instinctively afraid. He opened his mouth to say something, but no sound came out. Then he collapsed.
West of the city. South of the city. North of the city. The center of the city. At every point, people from the Tianque Sect were falling. Twelve elders, twenty-five deacons, and one hundred inner disciples. These people are the backbone of Tianque Sect and the foundation for the operation of the sect. Their spiritual energy was drained, and their bodies were like dry river beds, pale, skinny, and lifeless.
One hundred and thirty-seven people, all fell.
Among the crowd, a gray-white figure walked out. The hood was pulled down low, covering most of his face. He walked up to the altar step by step, stood beside the emperor, and looked down at the audience.
Ying Qi took off his hood, revealing his true appearance. No one in the audience recognized this face. But everyone recognized the aura on his body—grey, cold, and smelling of decay.
"Shadow Temple."
Four words are like four knives, piercing into everyone's heart.
Ying Qi raised his hand, and black mist poured out from the crack in the ground and wrapped around his arm.
"This city belongs to me." A voice from hell came out.
